title: Hotbar Layout Editor
description: Make your hotbar finally feel like yours. Move and hide individual hotbar slots with a simple in game editor.
body:
## 🌐 ITITAN Hosting
[![ITITAN Hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3geETR/images/refs/heads/main/Other/ititan.png)](https://ititanhosting.com/game/minecraft)


# Hotbar Layout Editor

**Customize your Minecraft hotbar layout directly in game.**

Move each slot individually, move the whole hotbar as a group, hide GUI slots visually.

---

## Clean Gui
![Editor Gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/280de60e091cacfd6481f92ae7f41a7d3f457a90.png)

---

## How to Use
- Press `H` to open the editor
- Choose your editing mode:
  - **Group**: Drag to move all slots together
  - **Individual**: Drag each slot separately
- Right-click on the slot you want to hide. Right-click again to make it visible again.
- Enable **Snap** for grid-aligned positioning
- Click the "Reset" button to clear the changes
- Click the "Save & Close" button to save your changes

![Using the editor](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExemtod2xyZWZwY3N1OThsNXhiMHY5bGloMmxoaHczOHp4aGI5enVieiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/19ZOY9laYyAWdWk2xF/giphy.gif)

---
This mod is **client-side only** and safe to use on any server. It does not modify inventory behavior, send packets, or require server-side installation.
